description: The persistent sticky header. Rendered by Layout for every route, so it is a node on every template. Three states; the theme of the top state is per-route CMS data (`pageOptions.headerTheme`).

theme.note: `white` on /platform and all 6 industry routes; `dark` everywhere else, including /security (explicitly "black") and /about (pageOptions:null, falls through to the dark default).

motion.notes: MEASURED: scrollY 300 = dark, 301 = white. The scrolled state swaps the Button variant outright rather than hovering it, and adds {elevation.lg}.

responsive.lg1024: desktop nav appears, burger hides, mega-menu becomes horizontal

knownUpstreamDefects: The Platform mega-menu panel renders a genuinely EMPTY <ul> — its CMS `linkList` is null. Reproduced on purpose.
The industries mega-menu entry "Telecommunications " carries a real trailing space in the label.
